Glasses restore

Seamstresses, mechanics, farmers, teachers — nearly every trade depends on clear sight. Glasses keep people earning, serving, connecting.

Hope and Life

Glasses improve a person’s quality of life today. The Gospel can give life today… and forever. That’s why we make every exam, every lens, and every fitting point to Jesus.

What we do

We serve in order to give the Gospel a doorway.

We partner with local indigenous Christian ministries to meet needs and to draw people to Christ.

We provide vision screening training, eye care services, and glasses to those who need them most.

Where we’re headed next

We have big plans for the people of Cuba.

We want to create a full service optical lab!

  • Decades of severe economic difficulty have left Cuba without any functioning optical labs.
  • Cubans have no access to prescription glasses.
  • We are partnering with a local Christian ministry to build a fully functioning optical lab.
  • Full surfacing lab grinding exact prescription lenses set in quality frames.
  • Providing 4-6 full-time jobs.
  • Staffed by local Cuban Christians with a heart for evangelism.
  • Providing glasses, jobs, evangelism, and HOPE.

Where we’ve already been

In many parts of India, an eye doctor is simply out of reach.

For families in rural India, the nearest eye doctor can be a day’s journey away — and even then, a real pair of prescription glasses is often unaffordable. Children strain to read the blackboard for years before anyone realizes it’s a vision problem at all.

In November 2018, our team partnered with Covenant Children’s Homes and India Christian Ministries for a six-day mission: vision screenings, real eye exams, and prescription glasses fitted on site — alongside the message of the Gospel, shared through a local church that continues that work today.

  • 600 vision screenings completed in six days.
  • 125 full eye exams by licensed optometrists.
  • 103 pairs of prescription glasses fitted and given away.
  • One people, one Church, one God to whom all glory is due.
103

prescription glasses delivered in just six days — each one an open door to share the Gospel.
